Hello everyone!

I have updated the lineup! These hybrid phone cases have now been designed to fit the **iPhone 16, 16 Pro, and 16 Pro Max**

### **The Perfect Hybrid: TPU meets PLA**

These cases are printed primarily out of **TPU 95A** with a separate drop-in back panel printed in **PLA** to give it maximum impact strength. The interlaced TPU acts as a bumper to absorb and distribute any impacts. Together, it creates a really pleasing combination of look, texture, and feel in the hand.

_(Note: Some of the examples in the images are early prototypes and might look a bit rough. Your final prints will look much better!)_

### **Assembly Instructions**

Assembly is quite straightforward, though you will need to use a little effort to get the rigid back panel into place.

1. **Fit the Frame:** Flex the TPU frame around the PLA back panel.
2. **Lock it in:** Once loosely in place, press down all around the back of the case to embed the TPU into the PLA back panel. There is a very slight taper to the design to help lock them together securely.
3. **Pro Tip:** I have found that rubbing something round and smooth against the back helps press everything in nicely!

_(Don't want to fiddle around too much? There is an extra **Flat Back Panel** included in the print profile for an easier fit)._

### **Printing Profile & Tips**

- **First Layer Settings:** I've set the first layer to print at a slow **20 mm/s**. If you manually increase your print temperature by 10 degrees for the TPU first layer, you should get a beautifully smooth finish.
- **Build Plate:** These have all been tested and perfected on the **Smooth Plate**.
- **Part Removal:** Gently remove the TPU bumper from the build plate. I don't use any release agent, and they peel away nicely, wait to cool or the warm TPU might deform!
- **The PLA Panel:** You can safely set your speeds back to your default PLA settings for the rigid back panel part; otherwise, it will take a few minutes longer than necessary.

I’d love to see what colour combinations you choose for your setups!
